title: Symphonic Études - No. 1
notable_excerpt: Key: C# minor. Chord journey: i - iv - V7 - V - i - bVI - i - bVII7 - V6 - i64 - i, bVI colour recurs, closes i with V6 - i. Texture: chordal theme in block harmony over a steady bass.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #289811 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1887), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~98%, pitch ~96% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op13_symphonic_etudes_1.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Symphonic Études Op. 13.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
